_comment: Pace API writes used by approve_proof and the automation service.
PLACEHOLDERS: the paths and bodies below are NOT real Pace endpoints. The Pace admin fills them in
from your Pace version's API documentation (EPACE web services / REST), then tests against a
Pace TEST system with PACE_ALLOW_WRITE=true and PACE_ALLOWED_STATUSES set.
Placeholders: {job_number}, {status}, {note}. They are URL-encoded in 'path' and escaped for
the content_type (JSON or XML) in 'body'. For JSON bodies do NOT put quotes around them.
Only 'update_job_status' and 'add_job_note' are supported. Leave one out to keep it manual.
base_url may be set here or with PACE_API_URL (the env var wins). Credentials: PACE_API_USERNAME /
PACE_API_PASSWORD (HTTP basic auth). Extra 'headers' are sent as-is: never put secrets in this file.
